programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: Passionate Italian baker Marco Poloni enters a baking competition entitled "The Golden Whisk" to attract publicity and win prize money to support his struggling family-owned bakery in the Bronx. He asks for the help of uptight Manhattan-based pastry-maker Grace Carpenter. The unlikely pair must win to pursue their dreams and to show up an old rival of Poloni's who has also entered the competition. Along the way Marco and Grace seem to find a mutual attraction for each other.

programme.title: The Poseidon Adventure
programme.desc: A cruise ship succumbs to a terrorist act and capsizes on New Year's eve. A ragtag group of survivors, spearheaded by a Priest and a homeland security agent, must journey through the upside down vessel and attempt an escape.

programme.title: Charms for the Easy Life
programme.desc: Drama with Gena Rowlands. The story of three women who live in a North Carolina town and defy the traditional roles set forth for them by society.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.desc: Drugged-out Shaun Ryder (Walliams) and classically-trained dancer and musical star Bez (Lucas) discuss their roots, daily living routine and a rather nice package holiday they went on. (24 December 2000).

programme.title: Flood
programme.desc: Flood is a disaster film set in London and Scotland. Estranged meteorologist father Leonard and Marine Engineer son are caught up in a weather related catastrophe...

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: Good Fences is about an upwardly-mobile Black family for whom the American dream becomes a nightmare. In the 1970s, Tom Spader is an attorney who is determined to end what he has dubbed "the colored man's losing streak." When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A hapless grifter stands to inherit a small fortune from his estranged grandmother if he travels to Harmony, Texas to live with her. Instead of a short road to easy money, he finds a soft spot in his heart for the little town and unconditional love from his only living relative.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Falling in Love with the Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Bridget Connolly (Patty Duke) and Betsy Lucas (Shelley Long) are two social climbing society women from Santa Catalina Island, California who have been continuous rivals for some unknown reason. But when Betsy's son Mark falls in love with the girl next door—who happens to be Bridget's daughter Theresa—the two women put all of their energy in to planning the wedding, much to the chagrin of their children.

programme.title: The Circus
programme.desc: Welsh drama. Set in 1848, this is the story of a young girl who is bewitched by the excitement of the travelling circus as it visits her small town in west Wales.

programme.title: Two Fathers: Justice for the Innocent
programme.desc: Two fathers from very different backgrounds reunite after eight years to pursue the escaped drug dealer responsible for the deaths of their son and daughter.

programme.title: Out of the Woods
programme.desc: Drama with Jason London. A self-absorbed young lawyer with ties to the material things in life gets an eye-opening experience when he visits his nature-loving grandfather.

programme.title: On Thin Ice / Breaking Through
programme.desc: Lucia Lobo is a nurse that cannot have children, so she stole 3 babies from the hospital. Filipe, her husband is fooled by thinking he's the one who can't have kids. When her children start to unveil the past, problems begin.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: Ronald Reagan turned from a liberal movie star to an exceptionally conservative politician and stunned the nation when he became governor of the largest state. The Reagans skilfully used American myth-making to rise to power. This documentary also takes a look at the relentless shift to the right of business, prompting Reagan to become a champion of a contained government.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: An analysis of Reagan's view of the race issue and his role as an advocate of authority and order who used racist strategies to win elections. The similarities with the current political landscape and the tactics employed by some Republicans are striking. Nancy also comes to the fore as a political force.

programme.title: A Bear Named Winnie
programme.desc: Based on the true story behind author A.A. Milne's beloved character, Winnie the Pooh, this is a tale of the remarkable friendship between a Canadian soldier and the cub that stood as a symbol of friendship and hope in a world plagued by war.

programme.title: Prairie Fever
programme.desc: Western adventure starring Kevin Sorbo and Dominique Swain. A drunken former lawman is given the chance to clear his debts by escorting three eccentric women back East. (2008).

programme.title: The Hot Potato
programme.desc: London's East End 1969. Based on real events. Two chancers "find" a lump of Uranium and crisscross Europe to find a buyer. Accompanied by Danny's girl,the lovely Carole. They encounter a diverse cast of bizarre characters, all trying to steal the 'Hot Potato', but a deal agreed inside the Vatican has the co-conspirators confounding each other. The story twists and turns to an exciting and unexpected finale.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: The group arrives in Paris, where Isabelle confronts her past while growing closer to Daryl; Codron seeks help from the leader of a growing nationalist movement called Pouvoir, putting the Union of Hope and Laurent under dangerous scrutiny.

programme.title: Scott Turow's Reversible Errors
programme.desc: A corporate lawyer's interest in a decade-old murder case is piqued by a new confession that could clear the convicted killer, who sits on death row.

programme.title: Scott Turow's Reversible Errors
programme.desc: A corporate lawyer's interest in a decade-old murder case is piqued by a new confession that could clear the convicted killer, who sits on death row.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: DreamKeeper
programme.desc: The film opens with Eagle Boy, a young man who is on a vision quest. It then cuts to the present, where a 17-year-old Lakota named Shane Chasing Horse is living on the Pine Ridge reservation. He is in trouble because he owes some money to a local gang—money he used to buy a beautiful ring for Mae Little Wounded, a girl he likes. Meanwhile, his mother asks him to drive his grandfather, Pete Chasing Horse, a storyteller, down to the powwow. Shane is reluctant. However, when the gang comes after him, Shane changes his mind and heads out to the powwow with his grandfather, who agrees to give him his truck once they reach the powwow. Grandfather tells Shane the story of a young Lakota man who tries to win the hand of Bluebird Woman. He also tells the story of how a thunder spirit falls in love with a Mohawk woman and brings her up into the ethereal world of Sky Woman, and of how she raised their son back in her village until he was struck by one of the villagers and brought back to live with his father.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.desc: A fearless rogue soldier, a former general and the U.S. President become pawns in a deadly contest of wills on a global scale.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

Great, that is, until the Hollywood set decides that motherhood is the newest way to go. When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Fenerbahçe“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Playoffs G2. Real Madrid - Hapoel TA
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lion V Buffalo. Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: The lines between hunter and hunted become blurred in this epic safari. Hold on to your seats as an elephant charges through the bush with a lion dangling from its tusks. Watch as male leopards engage in a turf war, and a pack of hyenas bully a lion off of his buffalo kill. The safari intensifies as a leopard, wild dogs and hyenas fight for the same kill in an astonishing display of raw nature.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Brand new series. Savute, Botswana: 2000 square miles of remote African savannah. This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Their survival depends on the giant herds of powerful prey - buffalo, elephant and zebra - who have roamed Savute in search of sustenance, season after season, millennium after millennium. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. In this episode, a small family of wild dogs goes on the run, desperately looking for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. But the Savage Kingdom will test them to the limit. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo
programme.desc: With more than 10,000 animals in their care and over 2.4 million guests welcomed a year, the Columbus Zoo and Aquarium and The Wilds have many compelling stories to tell. programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: The Kalahari. Land of great thirst. Endless mirages of red and yellow sand merge with a shimmering horizon. Summer rains bring brief explosions of life, painting the landscape in vibrant colours, only to be soaked up by the thirsty earth and returned once again to the desert. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Time Out: Kowalski's invention that stops time falls into the worst hands possible. King Julien's. The lemur promptly breaks it trapping the two of them in a world frozen in time. Instead of being a disaster, however, they realize they can do everything their hearts desire invent like crazy, perform on Broadway, play tennis in the middle of the street. But even an infinite playland like this can't last forever! Our Man in Grrfurjiclestan: Special Agent Buck Rockgut makes a "triumphant" return. While hunting the Red Squirrel across the globe, the crusty old bird contacts the penguins with a warning that the diabolical squirrel has a brainwashed sleeper agent among them. They battle each other to a standstill to uncover the agent - will it tear the unit apart? Can trust ever be restored? They have to take a trip to a faraway borough to uncover the truth.".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: "SpongeBob adopts a stray worm, and to his surprise, the worm gives birth to some worm babies overnight! But since Gary won't play nice, SpongeBob needs to find loving homes for his new slimey, weird-looking friends. / Plankton is sick of Karen's criticisms, so he decides he can just replace her with some new computer inventions! But when he takes them out on a Krabby Patty formula-stealing mission, he learns that Karen truly is one of a kind".

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. From fighting a gang of squirrels to stealing bikes from Randl the grumpy raccoon, there are tons of adventures to be had in Bigbark Woods. Harvey, Fee and Foo are ready to cause some trouble and have a blast along the way.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: When Gina's picnic is rained out, Wally decides to cheer her up by throwing a surprise picnic! He'll need his friends to keep her distracted and his magic stick to create H words that will help make the picnic happen!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father's from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father; in which Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down. His friendship is put to the test, as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: FA Cup
programme.desc: The FA Cup is the oldest knock-out tournament in England. Provided the Football Association, the competition provides raw emotion through "giant-killings" and 'underdog stories'. Premier League clubs enter in the third round of the tournament and with non-league teams starting the proceedings , n the early qualifying rounds, it promises to be another successful spectacle for viewers. In navigating to the latter stages of the knock-out rounds, teams all receive an amount of prize money that can be re-invested into training facilities and improvements to their respected grounds. With the final at Wembley, our exclusive coverage of this historic tournament will provide in-depth analysis and information. In keeping with the traditions of the trophy, Arsenal FC are the most successful (13).

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel gangster-movie capolavoro di Brian De Palma, sceneggiato da Oliver Stone. Il rifugiato cubano Tony Montana scala i vertici della malavita e diventa il re del narcotraffico.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Soldado
programme.desc: Stefano Sollima dirige Benicio Del Toro e Josh Brolin nel sequel di "Sicario". Ingaggiato dall'FBI, un uomo misterioso intensifica la guerra al narcotraffico fra Messico e Stati Uniti.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: Suburra
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Elio Germano, Claudio Amendola e Alessandro Borghi nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Tra corruzione dilagante e malavita si consuma la feroce lotta per il potere a Roma.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata

Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al capolavoro diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood con Hilary Swank e Morgan Freeman. Un anziano e burbero allenatore di boxe trasforma una tenace ragazza in una campionessa.

programme.title: Les Mise'rables
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro
programme.desc: Michael J.Fox nel primo capitolo della trilogia cult di Robert Zemeckis. Anni '80: con una macchina del tempo, l'adolescente Marty McFly finisce nel 1955 e incontra i suoi futuri genitori.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La West Coast, dove i lupi perlustrano le coste, le lontre si tuffano tra le onde, le balenottere azzurre si rincorrono e fanno capriole e i polpi compiono un sacrificio estremo per i loro piccoli.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La Patagonia è una regione selvaggia all'estremità meridionale delle Americhe. Sulle sue spettacolari montagne innevate si nascondono i pericolosissimi puma, mentre nelle sue immense praterie si aggirano i nandù.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Fiaba di arti marziali con un simpatico e goloso panda. Secondo un'antica profezia, Po sarebbe il prescelto 'Guerriero del Dragone'. Si affida così a un severo maestro di Kung Fu.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Il giro del mondo in 80 giorni
programme.desc: Colorato adattamento animato del capolavoro di Jules Verne. La scimmietta Passepartout e il ranocchio Phileas partono per un folle viaggio per battere il record di un famoso esploratore.

programme.title: 10 Lives - Un Gatto Fortunato
programme.desc: Divertente animazione targata Sky Original. Dopo aver perso la sua nona e ultima vita, al pigro micio Becket non resta che supplicare un'ultima possibilità al guardiano del Paradiso.

programme.title: Rosa Elettrica - Giannetta Vs Di Napoli
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco Di Napoli ripercorrono la loro esperienza durante le riprese, tra aneddoti divertenti e curiosita' dal backstage.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: Paws of Fury: La leggenda di Hank
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura animata targata Sky Original. Hank, un adorabile cane che sogna di diventare samurai, prende lezioni da un maestro, ma un perfido gatto minaccia il villaggio.

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer
programme.desc: Fabio Volo, Ginevra Francesconi e Giulia De Lellis nella commedia Sky Original di Michela Andreozzi. Un prof si scontra con la figlia teenager per colpa dei social... ma diventa influencer.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: Il marchio DreamWorks su un film d'animazione tratto dai libri a fumetti per bambini di Dav Pilkey. Feriti in un incidente, un cane poliziotto e il suo collega umano sono sottoposti a un intervento che li fonde insieme. Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Biancaneve
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e' la Regina Cattiva in un'irriverente versione della famosa fiaba. Dopo la morte del padre, Biancaneve deve affrontare la perfida matrigna. Sara' aiutata da 7 nanetti briganti.

programme.title: Speciale: Rosa Elettrica
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco di Napoli in fuga attraverso l'Italia: un dietro le quinte svela retroscena, location e scene action della serie.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: Biancaneve e il cacciatore
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth e Charlize Theron nella rilettura della famosa fiaba. La crudele regina incarica un cacciatore di uccidere la figliastra Biancaneve, in fuga verso il bosco.

programme.title: Speciale: Rosa Elettrica
programme.desc: Maria Chiara Giannetta e Francesco di Napoli in fuga attraverso l'Italia: un dietro le quinte svela retroscena, location e scene action della serie.

programme.title: Il mistero della casa del tempo
programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.title: Qua la zampa 2 - Un amico è per sempre
programme.desc: Commovente sequel con Dennis Quaid e Kathryn Prescott. Costretto a separarsi dalla sua piccola amica umana, il cane Bailey decide che nelle sue prossime vite la trovera' e la proteggera'.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Moon il panda
programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Belle e Sebastien - Next Generation
programme.desc: Un omaggio ai personaggi creati da Cecile Aubry ambientato ai giorni nostri. Il giovane Sebastien, in vacanza in montagna dalla nonna, stringe amicizia con un bellissimo cane Patou.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Il mistero della casa del tempo
programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Dolcissime
programme.desc: Delicata commedia di Francesco Ghiaccio. Tre ragazze derise per il loro aspetto cercano il riscatto in una gara di nuoto sincronizzato. Nel cast Vinicio Marchioni e Valeria Solarino.

programme.title: Vicky e il suo cucciolo
programme.desc: Toccante storia di amicizia sui monti del Cantal. Dopo la morte della madre, la piccola Victoria si e' chiusa nel mutismo. Un cucciolo di lupo le restituira' la voce e il sorriso.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe al magico fantasy con Cynthia Erivo e Ariana Grande. Nel regno di Oz, l’aspirante strega Galinda conosce la solitaria Elphaba. Canzoni in lingua originale.

programme.title: Belle e Sebastien - Next Generation
programme.desc: Un omaggio ai personaggi creati da Cecile Aubry ambientato ai giorni nostri. Il giovane Sebastien, in vacanza in montagna dalla nonna, stringe amicizia con un bellissimo cane Patou.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: La maledizione del coniglio mannaro
programme.desc: Oscar come miglior film d'animazione per una strabiliante avventura. Wallace e Gromit devono fermare un enorme e vorace coniglio che sta per rovinare la fiera dell'ortaggio gigante (GBR 2005).

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cattivissimo me", lo spin-off che ripercorre la storia dei buffi personaggi, sempre alla ricerca di un cattivo da servire: dalla Preistoria fino alla Londra degli anni 60.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.title: Come far litigare mamma e papà
programme.desc: Brillante commedia per tutta la famiglia con Giampaolo Morelli e Carolina Crescentini. Invidioso dei compagni di classe, Gabriele elabora un piano per far separare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe al magico fantasy con Cynthia Erivo e Ariana Grande. Nel regno di Oz, l’aspirante strega Galinda conosce la solitaria Elphaba. Canzoni in lingua originale.

programme.title: Dolcissime

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Blade II
programme.desc: Il cacciatore di vampiri Wesley Snipes, ispirato a un fumetto della Marvel Comics, torna in un secondo episodio sempre più ricco di d'azione e combattimenti. Questa volta dovrà vedersela con un terribile nemico, Jared Nomak, a capo di una nuova e più spietata razza di mutanti che fa strage di uomini e di vampiri per dominare il mondo. Solo la precaria alleanza proprio con i vampiri, che Blade ha sempre combattuto. potrà dare una speranza all'umanità. Fra discoteche e fogne, la caccia al mutante è aperta, ma Blade scoprirà una verità sconcertante.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: War movie di Roland Emmerich con Woody Harrelson e Dennis Quaid. Giugno, 1942: nell'atollo di Midway la Marina degli Stati Uniti reagisce all'attacco della flotta imperiale giapponese.

programme.title: Bullet Train
programme.desc: Avvincente action-comedy di David Leitch con Brad Pitt. Un sicario sale sul treno che collega Tokyo a Kyoto per rubare una valigia ma scopre di essere circondato da criminali.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: John Cusack e Thomas Jane ("Hung - Ragazzo squillo") in uno sfrenato action ad altissima velocita'. Simon Keller, un famoso ladro americano, ha bisogno di un autista per mettersi in salvo dopo una rapina in banca. Alla fine la scelta cade su Peter Roberts, un ex pilota di Formula Uno, all'oscuro dei piani del criminale. Keller lo assume come istruttore e mette a segno il colpo proprio durante una delle lezioni di guida. Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.desc: Will Smith e Martin Lawrence in un action dal regista di "Transformers". Due poliziotti braccano una banda di narcotrafficanti. L'unica che puo' aiutarli e' una prostituta che viene rapita.

programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga, Venom e il suo ospite umano, Eddie Brock, sono di ritorno a New York ma devono guardarsi dalle forze dell'ordine e dagli Xenofagi, indistruttibili mostri alieni provenienti dal pianeta di Venom.

programme.desc: Action-comedy con Jack Quaid e Ray Nicholson. Nate e' un timido banchiere affetto da una rara malattia che lo rende insensibile al dolore fisico. Ma questa sindrome, pericolosa e maledetta, diventa la sua arma per liberare la donna che ama da una banda di criminali.

Gia', perche' Jill e' convinta che dietro la scomparsa della sorella ci sia la stessa persona. Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.desc: Spy-thriller bellico di Alfred Hitchcock. Alla vigilia della 2a guerra mondiale, un operaio viene accusato di sabotaggio. Per provare la sua innocenza dovrà scoprire i veri colpevoli.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original con John Boyega, Olivia Cooke e Bill Skarsgard. Deluso dal sistema giudiziario, un avvocato idealista si ritrova coinvolto nel furto di una partita di droga.

programme.desc: Jack Nicholson nel capolavoro di Kubrick tratto da Stephen King. Dopo aver accettato l'impiego di custode, uno scrittore si trasferisce con la famiglia in un remoto hotel di montagna.

programme.title: Innamorarsi
programme.desc: Un'intensa storia romantica con la straordinaria coppia da Oscar, Robert De Niro-Meryl Streep. Lui ingegnere, lei disegnatrice pubblicitaria, si incontrano casualmente in una libreria di New York, alla vigilia di Natale. Si rivedono poi ogni giorno, sul treno per andare a lavoro. Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... David di Donatello alla Streep come miglior attrice straniera.

Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. programme.title: The Panti Sisters

programme.title: Exes Baggage
